wargov_pursue.name: Department of War — PURSUE UAP Releases
wargov_pursue.description: Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE). Rolling declassified releases starting May 2026: PDFs, images, and videos spanning 1948-2026 from DoW, FBI, NASA, State.

nara_uap.name: U.S. National Archives — UAP Records (incl. RG 615 & Project Blue Book)
nara_uap.description: Bulk ZIP downloads of all digitized UAP records in the National Archives Catalog: Record Group 615 (UAP Records Collection, 2024 NDAA transfers from ODNI/OSD/FAA/NRC), Project Blue Book case files, and related textual/microfilm holdings. ZIPs of images/PDFs plus JSON metadata per record; refreshed ~3x per year.

cia_foia.name: CIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room — UFO collections
cia_foia.description: CIA's declassified UFO holdings (1940s-1990s): the 'UFOs: Fact or Fiction?' special collection plus CREST records surfaced by keyword search. ~2,780+ pages as individual PDFs.
cia_foia.notes: The Black Vault CIA CD-ROM ZIP (below) is the fastest bulk path for the same corpus.

fbi_vault.name: FBI Vault — UFO / Majestic 12 / Roswell / Guy Hottel / Project Blue Book
fbi_vault.description: FBI FOIA reading room. UFO file in 16 parts (1947-1954 era reports, field office dispatches) plus related files: Majestic 12, Roswell, the Guy Hottel memo, and Project Blue Book correspondence.

nsa_ufo.name: NSA — Declassified UFO documents
nsa_ufo.description: NSA FOIA 'Frequently Requested' UFO records: SIGINT-related UFO reports, affidavits, and analyses.

aaro.name: AARO — All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office
aaro.description: Official AARO reports, resolved-case cards, and UAP records portal.

odni.name: ODNI — UAP assessments and annual reports
odni.description: Office of the Director of National Intelligence UAP assessments (2021 preliminary + annual reports).

dodig.name: DoW Inspector General — UAP-related records
dodig.description: DoW Office of Inspector General FOIA reading room UAP records (e.g. evaluation of DoW actions on UAP).

navy.name: U.S. Navy / NAVAIR FOIA — UAP videos & records
navy.description: Officially released FLIR1, GIMBAL, and GO FAST videos and UAP documents via NAVAIR and SECNAV FOIA reading rooms.
navy.notes: NAVAIR FOIA library is a JS app; the three famous videos are included in war.gov Release 01.

geipan.name: GEIPAN (CNES, France) — case files & open data
geipan.description: French space agency UAP office. Publishes every investigated case since 1977; downloadable CSV exports at case and testimony level.

uk_mod.name: UK National Archives — Ministry of Defence UFO files
uk_mod.description: ~52,000 pages of MoD UFO desk records (DEFE 24/31/AIR series), transferred to Kew 2008-2017. Full digitised sets are pay-per-download via Discovery; free extracts and highlight guides exist.
uk_mod.notes: Bulk DEFE series downloads require paid Discovery orders — flagged manual.

canada_lac.name: Library and Archives Canada — Canada's UFOs
canada_lac.description: ~9,500 digitized pages (of ~15,000) of Canadian government UFO records 1950-1990s, incl. the Falcon Lake incident. Searchable database; an 8,000-page consolidated set is mirrored on Internet Archive (item CanadaUFO, ingested via the internet_archive source).

australia_naa.name: National Archives of Australia — UFO files
australia_naa.description: 130+ folders (A703, A9755 series etc.) of RAAF/DoD UFO investigations, released under the 30-year rule. Consolidated PDFs mirrored on Internet Archive (item AustralianUFOFiles) and The Black Vault.

brazil_an.name: Arquivo Nacional (Brazil) — OVNI / SIOANI files
brazil_an.description: Brazilian Air Force UFO records transferred after the 2012 FOIA law: SIOANI system files and Operação Prato. Consolidated set mirrored on Internet Archive (item BrazilianUFOFiles).

nz_defence.name: New Zealand Defence Force — UFO files 1952-2009
nz_defence.description: Declassified NZDF UFO files released under the Official Information Act (sightings, investigations, correspondence).
nz_defence.notes: Hosted by National Library of NZ; mirrored across community archives.

blackvault.name: The Black Vault — FOIA document archive
blackvault.description: Largest private archive of FOIA-obtained government documents (~4M pages). UFO Phenomena category spans CIA, NSA, DIA, Navy, Australia, and the processed war.gov UFO Files releases.

internet_archive.name: Internet Archive — UFO document collections
internet_archive.description: Curated archive.org items/collections: complete Project Blue Book NARA microfilm reels, the 10,000+ case-file Blue Book set, and consolidated Canadian / Australian / Brazilian government files.
internet_archive.notes: Items enumerated at runtime via the archive.org metadata API: nara-pbb (collection), bluebook, project-blue-book (collection), ProjectBlueBookGuide, CanadaUFO, AustralianUFOFiles, BrazilianUFOFiles.

nicap.name: NICAP — National Investigations Committee on Aerial Phenomena
nicap.description: Historic civilian investigation org (1956-1980). Site hosts case directories, 'The UFO Evidence', and scanned primary documents.

afu_se.name: AFU — Archives for the Unexplained (Sweden)
afu_se.description: World's largest physical UFO archive (3.5 km of shelving). files.afu.se exposes a public Downloads directory including scanned magazines, report files, and the Isaac Koi archives.

majestic.name: Majestic Documents
majestic.description: Scans of the disputed MJ-12 document set with provenance analyses. Included for corpus completeness; authenticity contested.

bluebookarchive.name: Project Blue Book Archive
bluebookarchive.description: Scanned Blue Book / Project Sign / NICAP-CSI microfilm rolls with case indexes.
bluebookarchive.notes: Same microfilm is bulk-downloadable via internet_archive (nara-pbb); use that path.

nuforc.name: NUFORC — National UFO Reporting Center datasets
nuforc.description: 140k+ sighting reports since 1974. Community-maintained scrapes provide geocoded, time-standardized CSV/JSON dumps.

ufo_data_richgel.name: richgel999/ufo_data — 'Dataset of the Damned' chronology
ufo_data_richgel.description: Curated machine-readable chronology of UFO/UAP events compiled from major published timelines; JSON/markdown.

github_mirrors.name: GitHub mirrors of the war.gov PURSUE releases & NUFORC
github_mirrors.description: Redundant clones of the PURSUE releases (with OCR text, markdown conversions, checksums) and NUFORC scrape tooling. Useful when war.gov throttles or files move. Cloned, not scraped.
